name: Broadcom Inc.
blurb: Broadcom is a diversified semiconductor and infrastructure software company formed through a series of acquisitions, most recently VMware (closed 2023). Its chip portfolio spans networking ASICs (custom chips for hyperscaler AI clusters), enterprise storage controllers, WiFi silicon, and set-top-box processors. Broadcom's AI networking chips — particularly its Tomahawk Ethernet switching ASICs and custom AI accelerators built for Google, Meta, and Apple — have made it a second-tier AI infrastructure beneficiary behind NVIDIA. The VMware acquisition added high-margin enterprise software revenue that meaningfully improved the company's margin profile.
recent: Broadcom's FY2026 revenue (ending Oct 2026) is on track to exceed $65 billion, with AI-related chip revenue growing rapidly as hyperscalers expand custom silicon programs. Forward EPS growth of 56.3% and a forward P/E of ~23.4x produce a PEG of 0.42 — among the best risk-adjusted valuations in large-cap technology. CEO Hock Tan has guided to $60–90 billion in AI chip revenue by 2027 from three major hyperscaler customers alone.
